title: C# Multiple Choice Questions - Networking
description: This section of our 1000+ C# MCQs focuses on Networking in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: Which namespace is mostly preferred for the operation of networking in C#?
questions.explanation: The primary networking namespace is System.Net (TcpClient, TcpListener, Dns, IPAddress, WebRequest, and so on). System.Net.Mail is only email. System.Web is ASP.NET. System.in is Java, not .NET.

questions.question: Which of the following are the classes defined by the namespace System.Net?
Which of the following are the interfaces defined by the namespace System.Net?
questions.explanation: IAuthenticationModule is a System.Net interface. HttpWebRequest and WebProxy are classes; HttpResponseHeader is an enum.

questions.question: Which of the following are the classes that support the standard HTTP protocol?
questions.explanation: The derived classes that support the standard HTTP protocol are HttpWebRequest and HttpWebResponse.

questions.question: Which of the following class/classes supports the task of uploading and downloading the file?
questions.explanation: If we only need to upload or download a file, then WebClient is often the best way to accomplish it.

questions.question: How many ports of TCP/IP are reserved for specific protocols?
How many bits are present in a single IP address?
Which of the following is the full form of DNS?
Which of the following are the protocols defined by .NET runtime?
questions.explanation: The .NET runtime defines HTTP, HTTPS, file, and FTP protocols. Thus, if we specify a URI that uses HTTP prefix, we will automatically receive the HTTP-compatible class that supports it. If we specify a URI that uses FTP prefix, we will automatically receive the FTP-compatible class that supports it.
